heard: An entire exoplanet is made almost entirely of pure diamond. In 2011, astronomers using the Parkes radio telescope detected something very strange 4,000 light years away. The signal came from a millisecond pulsar rotating 10,000 times every minute. This tiny stellar corpse has a mass 1.4 times that of the sun. Circling that pulsar is a planet, completing an orbit every two hours and 10 minutes. The entire system is so compact it would fit entirely inside our Sun. This world is actually the remnant of a star that lost over 99% of its mass. That stolen core is 20 times denser than Jupiter and compressed into crystalline carbon.
